title: Week 12 Applied Lab: Domain-Specific LLM Architecture & Pre-Training Case Study
html:
Week 12 Applied Lab: Domain-Specific LLM Architecture & Pre-Training Case Study

Assignment Objective: Conduct an in-depth comparative study analyzing pre-training corpora, tokenization strategies, and domain adaptation in specialized industrial foundation models.

Laboratory Instructions & Tasks

Step 1: Industrial Model Selection

Select four specialized open-weights domain models from Hugging Face representing distinct verticals (e.g., Code: StarCoder/CodeLlama; Biomedicine: BioMedLM/BioMistral; Finance: FinGPT/BloombergGPT; Mathematics: Llama-Math).

Step 2: Pre-Training Data & Tokenization Profiling

For each selected model, research and document: (1) Pre-training token volume, (2) Source corpora curation and filtering methodologies, (3) Subword tokenizer design and vocabulary size, and (4) Compute hardware allocation (GPU hours).

Step 3: Sector Impact Analysis

Select two primary industry sectors (e.g., Healthcare & Banking) and evaluate how domain-adapted models solve problems where general-purpose frontier models struggle (e.g., compliance, jargon, hallucination risks).

Step 4: Comparative Research Paper

Write a 2,000-2,500 word technical research report with APA citations, comparative summary tables, and a strategic analysis of Chinchilla compute optimality applied to domain adaptation.

Submission Guidelines

  • Submission Types: Online text entry or file upload.
  • Allowed File Extensions: pdf,docx
  • Due Date: Sunday at 11:59 PM (Midnight) Mountain Time.
  • Total Points: 50.0 pts
